sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.used_for: §1 defines Special Links: links to an Amazon Site that "must properly use the special 'tagged' link formats we provide". §5 Identifying Yourself as an Associate, quoted verbatim: "You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.'" §5 also bars misrepresenting or embellishing the relationship, "including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you". §6 Term and Termination states that "any violation of Section 5 and as specified in the Program Policies will be deemed a material breach of this Agreement" - so a missing or buried disclosure is a termination-grade defect, not a style issue. This is why the build gate fails on any page without the statement. §4 states "We do not make any representation, warranty, or covenant regarding the amount of traffic or commission income you can expect at any time". That is the official basis for publishing no revenue forecast and no conversion score anywhere on this site.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Participation Requirements, Commission Income Statement, Products Statement, IP License, Trademark Guidelines)
sources.method: fetched. Earlier sessions read clauses (g), (q), (s), (u), (v), (w) and Trademark Guidelines 3(iv) in full but took §2(a)-(b) from a search-result excerpt and left a re-check note. sources.used_for: Quoted verbatim from the page as fetched 2026-11-20. · §2(a) Special Links: "Special Links enable accurate tracking, reporting, and accrual of commission income. Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you." · §2(b): "you must include your Associates ID or 'tag' (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site." This is the clause the supplied links fail on observation (FLG-003) and the clause that gives the published outbound links their required shape. It also fixes the tag format as XXXXX-## "or such other format as we may designate" (see FLG-031). · §2(b): "You must not encourage customers to bookmark your Special Links. All Special Links must be accessed directly from your Site." · §2(b): "You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices." Official basis for the no-hype editorial rule. · §2(b) prices: "your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API". Neither condition is met, so no price appears on this site and the gate fails the build if one does. · §2(b) promotions: "You must remove from your Site any links and related references to limited time promotions as soon as that promotion on the relevant Amazon Site ends." Constrains seasonal content (S-08). · §2(b) product lists: "When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link." · §3(b): responsibility for "displaying Special Links and Program Content on your Site in compliance with ... those related to disclosures (for example, if applicable, the U.S. FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsement and Testimonials in Advertising)". Amazon names the FTC Guides directly, so S07 and S08 are not optional extras. · §3(e): you must disclose "accurately and adequately ... either through a privacy policy or otherwise, the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies by you and third parties and how you collect, use, store, and disclose data collected from visitors". This is the clause behind FLG-029: the root site ships a click counter and no privacy notice. · §4 Promotional Limitations: Special Links may appear in email, SMS and direct messages only where "such communications are solicited (i.e., opted into by the receiving customer)". Constrains the reader-capture option (S-11). · §5: "You will not, without or express prior written approval, use, or allow any third party to use, any Special Links or Program Content to develop machine learning models or related technology." Directly constrains the AI-automation part of the brief (FLG-027). · §6(b): "you will not create links formatted with your Associates tag for, or display such links on, a site that is not your Site." Ties the tagged links to the declared-site question (Q-03, FLG-006). · §6(g): no consideration, reward or incentive for using Special Links - a click incentive in a reader-capture offer would breach this. · §6(s): "You will not artificially generate clicks or impressions on your Site or create Sessions on an Amazon Site, whether by way of a robot or software program or otherwise." Constrains how the analytics collector may be tested (no scripted click inflation). · §6(t): "You will not display or otherwise use any of our customer reviews or star ratings, in part or in whole, on your Site unless you have obtained a link to that customer review or star rating through Creators API or PA API". Official basis for the gate's no-ratings rule. · §6(u): you may not purchase through your own Special Links, nor permit or encourage friends, relatives, employees or contractors to do so. Gate G-02 must be tested by checking the destination and the tracking report, not by buying. · §6(v): "You will not cloak, hide, spoof, or otherwise obscure the URL of your Site containing Special Links (including by use of Redirecting Links) ... such that we cannot reasonably determine the site or application from which a customer clicks through". · §6(w): "You will not use a link shortening service, button, hyperlink or other ad placement in a manner that makes it unclear that you are linking to an Amazon Site." Note what this clause does and does not say: it turns on whether the Amazon destination is unclear. It does not ban shorteners as such. This is why FLG-003 is recorded as unresolved rather than as a violation. · §6(y): "Unless otherwise agreed by Amazon, your Site must not have price tracking and/or price alerting functionality." Bars the price analysis the brief asks for from being published as a site feature (FLG-028). · Preamble: "any violation of the Associates Program Participation Requirements, the Associates Program IP License or Section 1 of the Amazon Influencer Program Policy will be deemed a material breach of the Agreement." · Commission Income Statement §1: a Qualifying Purchase needs a click through a Special Link, and the Session ends at the first of 24 hours elapsing, an order being placed, or a click through someone else's Special Link; cart additions count for 89 days; the product must be shipped and paid for within 180 days. This is the mechanism the untagged links break.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.used_for: Quoted verbatim: rel="sponsored" is for links "that are advertisements or paid placements (commonly called paid links)". Multiple rel values may be given as a space- or comma-separated list, which is why the site emits rel="sponsored noopener". The page also states "Links marked with these rel attributes will generally not be followed", and that they are hints applying only to <a> elements Google can crawl. Page footer states "Last updated 2025-12-10 UTC".

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.used_for: Disclosures must be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement, and in the same language. Disclosures that appear only on an About page or behind a 'more' link are likely to be missed. 'sp', 'spon', 'collab' and stand-alone 'thanks' or 'ambassador' are too vague.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Central - Application review process (help)
sources.used_for: Associates require at least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days; personal orders do not count. Sites must have robust original content; the help text gives 'at least 10 posts' as a rule of thumb. Tags must be embedded in links on the sites declared in the application.
